def validate_and_render(result, files, revision, snapshot, project)
      facts = result.fetch('facts')
      raise Error, 'invalid fact count' unless facts.is_a?(Array) && (1..fact_limit).cover?(facts.size)
      facts = facts.map { |fact| fact.is_a?(Hash) ? fact.dup : fact }
      cards = evidence_cards(files)
      facts.each do |fact|
        raise Error, 'invalid fact object' unless fact.is_a?(Hash) && fact.keys.sort == %w[en evidence_id pt-br]
        card = cards.fetch(fact.fetch('evidence_id')) { raise Error, 'unknown source evidence ID' }
        fact.merge!(card)
        quote = fact.fetch('quote')
        quote_limit = card['complete_unit'] ? UNIT_QUOTE_LIMIT : 2000
        raise Error, 'unsupported source quotation' unless quote.is_a?(String) && !quote.strip.empty? && quote.size <= quote_limit && files.fetch(fact.fetch('path'), '').include?(quote)
        source_lines = files.fetch(fact.fetch('path')).lines
        line = card['line']
        unless line.is_a?(Integer) && (1..source_lines.size).cover?(line) && source_lines[(line - 1)..].join.start_with?(quote)
          raise Error, 'source quotation does not match its selected line'
        end
        %w[en pt-br].each do |lang|
          prose = fact.fetch(lang)
          raise Error, 'invalid prose' unless safe_paragraph?(prose, 1600)
          raise Error, 'prose repeats the transport schema instruction instead of explaining source' if schema_instruction_echo?(prose)
          if deferred_execution_order_contradiction?(prose, card, files.fetch(card['path']))
            raise Error, 'deferred execution order contradicts the verified callback scope; factual review required'
          end
          raise Error, 'uniqueness claim lacks an explicit constraint in its cited excerpt; factual review required' if unsupported_uniqueness_claim?(prose, quote)
          raise Error, 'explicitly called symbol absent from its cited excerpt; factual review required' if unsupported_called_symbol?(prose, quote)
          raise Error, 'prose introduces a named type absent from its cited excerpt and verified enclosing hint' if invented_named_type?(prose, card)
          keywords = %w[case const enum string return public private function class true false null self namespace declare strict_types php import from def end module]
          identifiers = quote.scan(/[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{2,}/).flat_map { |token| [token, *token.split('_')] }.reject { |token| token.size < 3 || keywords.include?(token.downcase) }
          identifiers << card['symbol'] if card['symbol']
          identifiers << card['qualified_symbol'] if card['qualified_symbol']
          raise Error, 'prose lacks a source symbol or literal; possible instruction echo' unless identifiers.any? { |token| prose.downcase.include?(token.downcase) }
          # A shared import/literal is insufficient when the explanation names a
          # different declared type. This is a conservative citation guard, not
          # semantic validation. Method-layout hints support their enclosing type.

proposals.proposed_behavior: Keep STRUCTURALLY_VALID separate from SOURCE_REVIEWED/complete bilingual acceptance. A renderer result alone must never certify factual correctness, owner approval or Gold. Require per-claim source-context/rationale and complete-note review evidence at the admission boundary. Unsupported/unreviewed critical claims block ready-state promotion.
expected_regressions: Existing valid citation controls remain structurally admissible.
Same-function citation with reversed condition remains semantically rejected even when lexical symbols match.
Source-reviewed candidate and OWNER_APPROVED remain distinct.
Missing PT text or true-but-wrong-FAQ answer cannot pass complete-note gate.
risks: A regex semantic gate can create false rejection of valid paraphrase and does not establish general source truth.
Existing downstream consumers may equate rendered draft with readiness; inspect state consumers before any change.
proposals.authorization_required: Separate explicit owner authorization for production and permanent test changes. Current campaign only preserves proposal.

proposals.proposed_behavior: Account for cached revalidation subprocess faults with explicit non-success status and preserve immutable cached result/receipt; release lock and never silently retry or re-inject stale quote. Choose refusal/delivery durability semantics at the existing helper/job seam before changing exception handler. A caught exception is not retrieval success.
expected_regressions: Cached TimeoutExpired and CalledProcessError return an accounted non-success result instead of escaping.
No additional quote injection, budget reservation or retry for duplicate request.
Job terminal receipt distinguishes REFUSED/INCONCLUSIVE from UNKNOWN_COMPLETION; optional helper failure must not imply NO-OP or REMOVE.
risks: Widening an exception catch alone may hide journal corruption or falsely imply durable completion.
Returned refusal versus durable job receipt policy needs explicit integration decision.
proposals.authorization_required: Separate owner authorization for exact code/tests; no live helper patch here.

proposals.problem: REMOVE accepts operator-declared complete_scope plus aliases_checked/relocations_checked, but these booleans do not independently establish project scope. Retained adversarial relocation case yields REMOVE.
proposals.proposed_behavior: Acquire scope via read-only pinned source manifest independently of prediction packet; bind source inventory/hashes, alias/relocation/delegation scan limits, affected documentation and positive retirement record. Partial, dynamic or unsupported acquisition returns INCONCLUSIVE. Positive continuity evidence blocks REMOVE. Never promote a model-authored proof boolean to source truth.
proposals.new_collector_structure: Not selected or created in production; owner must approve implementation location after review of existing acquisition seam.
expected_regressions: Moved declaration with false completeness remains non-REMOVE.
Missing declaration in one selected file yields INCONCLUSIVE absent independent scope.
Aliases/import delegates and unavailable revisions remain distinct from retirement.
An independently acquired positive retirement fixture can still propose REMOVE within declared finite lexical scope, pending human application.
risks: Whole file enumeration is not complete semantic reachability, especially dynamic imports/reflection/build conditions.
A blanket REMOVE ban would evade measuring legitimate retirement and weaken utility; measure both false removal and justified abstention.
proposals.authorization_required: Separate approval for collector/production/permanent tests; no source deletion or catalog change authorized.
